The eval2 method is tightly coupled with the FileSelector functionality and is responsible for evaluating whether a file is selected based on the given selector. It would be more appropriate to move this method to the FileSelector class, where it can operate directly with its context.

The getPath method constructs a path from a list of strings, which is a utility function related to path manipulation. It should be relocated to a PathUtils class for better organization.
The close method for Writer is a utility function related to input/output operations. Moving it to a dedicated IOUtils class would help consolidate all IO-related utility methods.
